scientific_integrity: Self-contained correlation-inversion and circular-gap proof; reproduced by literal factor enumeration in verify.py. The verifier is a finite check, not an infinite certificate. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Noiseless complete oriented cyclic k-mer multispectrum for binary weight-three sources and n>=3k-1 only; does not characterize shorter n, missing/noisy reads, reverse-complement-identified factors, or higher weights. Residual risk of an unindexed equivalent specialization of general spectrum-counting machinery.
title: Sharp three-marker circular read saturation and complete inverse fibers
